description: geomap.reteunitaria.piemonte.it: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geomap.reteunitaria.piemonte.it. Coverage: the area served by geomap.reteunitaria.piemonte.it. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Dati di base - Grafo stradale; BDTRE - Ponte/viadotto/cavalcavia (PONTE); BDTRE - Elemento stradale (EL_STR); BDTRE - Giunzione stradale (GZ_STR). Formats seen: WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
